localChanges: Clicking or tapping the round buttons beside the map (End turn, research, production, civil disorder, notices) or the trade rates and revolution buttons in the top bar works again. Since the last update they answered only the keyboard.

With ?interface=new added to the address, notices and cities in disorder show as rows above the Next Turn button, each in its own colour, with notices of one kind sharing a row and a count. Five rows at most, with the rest behind "+N more". Click a row to open it, and dismiss it for the turn with its ×, a right-click, or Delete (#416).
With ?interface=new, a city in disorder that you have dismissed no longer holds back auto end turn, so once you've dismissed them all the turn ends by itself (#416).
